verdict.rationale: Vanta documents background automation it runs itself: continuous automated tests and evidence collection from integrations (vanta-docs-10, vanta-docs-45), a TPRM Agent that automatically discovers vendors and monitors third-party risk (vanta-docs-13), and automated assessment reminders and workflows (vanta-docs-22). Users can also define Custom Tests that turn pushed data into pass/fail evidence (vanta-docs-2), but there is no documented user-configurable automation or agent builder, and the AI Agent and MCP flows are user-invoked rather than autonomous. Missing for 10: a documented user-facing way to create and schedule custom autonomous automations or agent tasks, detail on triggers and scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the background agents work as claimed.
